scope: Two completed native camera-matched renders; not an equal-work, convergence, or ground-truth benchmark

baseline.renderer: CYBR Observatory IV native CPU spectral tracer

common_finish.filter: Identical four-pass normal/depth/variance-guided a-trous filter on total radiance
common_finish.known_limit: First-surface center-sampled guides do not follow internal refraction or depth-of-field integration

comparison_boundaries: Different native spectral authoring and material models
UV-aligned native anisotropy replaces group-axis machining tangents
Native normal-map handling and bilinear texture lookup differ
Cauchy-fitted quartz differs slightly from source Sellmeier expression
Float32 degeneracy-filter rounding differs for 23 near-zero-area faces
Different CPU thread counts and spectral sampling work; render times must not be ranked directly

independent_tests.full_local_runner: 96x64, 2 packets, 4 wavelengths; completed with baseline unchanged
independent_tests.actual_source_zip_extraction_test: 64x48, 2 packets, 4 wavelengths; rebuilt both native executables and completed both renders with baseline unchanged
